description: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets originating from different countries over the years 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents “Year,” with labels ranging from 2012 to 2022 in sequential order, while the vertical axis represents “Number of datasets,” labeled with a logarithmic scale ranging from 10⁰ to 10² with tick marks at intervals of 10⁰ and 10¹.  The chart consists of grouped bars for each year, with each group representing the number of datasets from a specific country: UK (blue), USA (orange), IN (green), IT (purple), DE (brown), and Other (teal). In 2012, the UK has a bar of approximately 1, while “Other” has a bar of approximately 0.1. In 2022, the UK has a bar of approximately 80, while “Other” has a bar of approximately 15. The bars are grouped by year and colored by country, with the “Other” category consistently appearing first within each group. The bars are arranged chronologically by year, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
